title: modelbased: An R package to make the most out of your statistical models through marginal means, marginal effects, and model predictions
authors: Makowski, D., Ben-Shachar, M. S., Wiernik, B. M., Patil, I., Thériault, R., & Lüdecke, D.
summary: modelbased is the easystats package for the step after fitting: estimated marginal means, marginal effects, contrasts and model predictions, for any supported model, so that what a model implies can be read off directly rather than reconstructed from its coefficients.
